description: Defines structures and classes for handling DNS response messages, including resource records, parsers, and response buffers, as used in DNS protocol processing.

classes.name: DnsResourceRecord
classes.description: Represents a DNS resource record as specified in RFC 1035, including methods for size calculation and data management.

classes.name: DnsRecordParser
classes.description: Iterator class for parsing resource records from a DNS response packet.

classes.name: DnsResponse
classes.description: Buffer holder for DNS response data, providing methods for parsing, validation, and access to DNS message components.

methods.name: SetOwnedRdata(std::string value)
methods.description: Sets the owned_rdata field and updates rdata pointer.

methods.name: CalculateRecordSize()
methods.description: Calculates the size of the DNS resource record.

methods.name: DnsRecordParser(const void* packet, size_t length, size_t offset, size_t num_records)
AtEnd()
methods.description: Checks if parser has reached end of packet.

methods.name: ReadName(const void* pos, std::string* out)
methods.description: Parses a DNS name from packet data.

methods.name: DnsResponse(uint16_t id, bool is_authoritative, ...)
methods.description: Constructs a DNS response from components.

methods.name: DnsResponse(size_t length)
methods.description: Constructs a response buffer of specified length.

methods.name: DnsResponse(const void* data, size_t length, size_t answer_offset)
InitParse(size_t nbytes, const DnsQuery& query)
methods.description: Initializes parsing and validates response against query.

methods.name: id()
methods.description: Returns the response ID if available.

methods.name: Parser()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over answer resource records.
